mapper.sql: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members actor JOIN project_members mine ON mine.workspace_member_id = actor.workspace_member_id WHERE actor.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND actor.member_id = #{memberId} AND actor.status = 0 AND mine.project_id = p.project_id AND mine.status = 0)

AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members actor WHERE actor.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND actor.member_id = #{memberId} AND actor.status = 0 AND ( actor.role = 70 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members mine WHERE mine.project_id = p.project_id AND mine.workspace_member_id = actor.workspace_member_id AND mine.role = 50 AND mine.status = 0 ) ) )

SELECT 1 AS "reportCategory", pr.project_report_id AS "reportId", pr.project_id AS "projectId", '프로젝트 보고서' AS "reportTypeName", p.subject AS "projectName", '-' AS "taskName", pr.title AS "reportTitle", md.name AS "authorName", TO_CHAR(pr.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdDate", pr.created AS "sortDate", CASE p.status WHEN 0 THEN '예정' WHEN 1 THEN '진행 중' ELSE '완료' END AS "stageName", pr.progress AS "progress", CASE WHEN rr.status IN (1, 2) THEN rr.status + 2 WHEN rr.viewed IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS "reviewStatus" FROM project_reports pr JOIN projects p ON pr.project_id = p.project_id JOIN project_members pm ON pr.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id LEFT JOIN report_reviews rr ON rr.report_id = ( SELECT MAX(r2.report_id) FROM report_reviews r2 WHERE r2.project_report_id = pr.project_report_id AND r2.category = 1 ) WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS "reportCategory", tr.team_report_id AS "reportId", tr.project_id AS "projectId", '업무 보고서' AS "reportTypeName", p.subject AS "projectName", t.title AS "taskName", tr.title AS "reportTitle", md.name AS "authorName", TO_CHAR(tr.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdDate", tr.created AS "sortDate", TO_CHAR(t.task_level) || ' 단계' AS "stageName", tr.progress AS "progress", CASE WHEN rr.status IN (1, 2) THEN rr.status + 2 WHEN rr.viewed IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS "reviewStatus" FROM team_reports tr JOIN tasks t ON tr.task_id = t.task_id AND tr.project_id = t.project_id JOIN projects p ON tr.project_id = p.project_id JOIN project_members pm ON tr.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id LEFT JOIN report_reviews rr ON rr.report_id = ( SELECT MAX(r2.report_id) FROM report_reviews r2 WHERE r2.team_report_id = tr.team_report_id AND r2.category = 2 ) WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL AND tr.deleted IS NULL

sql.if: AND ( LOWER(R."projectName") LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{kwd}) || '%' OR LOWER(R."taskName") LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{kwd}) || '%' OR LOWER(R."reportTitle") LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{kwd}) || '%' OR LOWER(R."authorName") LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{kwd}) || '%' )

choose.when: SELECT pr.project_report_id AS "reportId", rr.report_id AS "reviewId", 1 AS "reportCategory", pr.project_id AS "projectId", pr.project_member_id AS "projectMemberId", '프로젝트 보고서' AS "reportTypeName", p.subject AS "projectName", '-' AS "taskName", pr.title AS "reportTitle", pr.content AS "content", md.name AS "authorName", TO_CHAR(pr.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdDate", CASE p.status WHEN 0 THEN '예정' WHEN 1 THEN '진행 중' ELSE '완료' END AS "stageName", pr.progress AS "progress", rr.review AS "reviewComment", rr.reject AS "rejectReason", TO_CHAR(rr.reviewed, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "reviewedDate", CASE WHEN rr.status IN (1, 2) THEN rr.status + 2 WHEN rr.viewed IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS "reviewStatus" FROM project_reports pr JOIN projects p ON pr.project_id = p.project_id JOIN project_members pm ON pr.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id LEFT JOIN report_reviews rr ON rr.report_id = ( SELECT MAX(r2.report_id) FROM report_reviews r2 WHERE r2.project_report_id = pr.project_report_id AND r2.category = 1 ) WHERE pr.project_report_id = #{reportId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL
choose.otherwise: SELECT tr.team_report_id AS "reportId", rr.report_id AS "reviewId", 2 AS "reportCategory", tr.project_id AS "projectId", tr.task_id AS "taskId", tr.project_member_id AS "projectMemberId", '업무 보고서' AS "reportTypeName", p.subject AS "projectName", t.title AS "taskName", tr.title AS "reportTitle", tr.content AS "content", md.name AS "authorName", TO_CHAR(tr.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdDate", TO_CHAR(t.task_level) || ' 단계' AS "stageName", tr.progress AS "progress", rr.review AS "reviewComment", rr.reject AS "rejectReason", TO_CHAR(rr.reviewed, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "reviewedDate", CASE WHEN rr.status IN (1, 2) THEN rr.status + 2 WHEN rr.viewed IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS "reviewStatus" FROM team_reports tr JOIN tasks t ON tr.task_id = t.task_id AND tr.project_id = t.project_id JOIN projects p ON tr.project_id = p.project_id JOIN project_members pm ON tr.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id LEFT JOIN report_reviews rr ON rr.report_id = ( SELECT MAX(r2.report_id) FROM report_reviews r2 WHERE r2.team_report_id = tr.team_report_id AND r2.category = 2 ) WHERE tr.team_report_id = #{reportId} AND tr.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL

mapper.select: SELECT pm.project_member_id FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN projects p ON pm.project_id = p.project_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND pm.status = 0 AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND wm.status = 0 AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY pm.role DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

choose.when: INSERT INTO report_reviews (report_id, project_report_id, project_member_id, status, viewed, category) SELECT seq_report_reviews.NEXTVAL, #{reportId}, #{reviewerProjectMemberId}, 0, SYSDATE, 1 FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM report_reviews WHERE project_report_id = #{reportId} AND category = 1)
choose.otherwise: INSERT INTO report_reviews (report_id, team_report_id, project_member_id, status, viewed, category) SELECT seq_report_reviews.NEXTVAL, #{reportId}, #{reviewerProjectMemberId}, 0, SYSDATE, 2 FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM report_reviews WHERE team_report_id = #{reportId} AND category = 2)

mapper.update: UPDATE report_reviews SET viewed = SYSDATE WHERE report_id = #{reviewId} AND status = 0 AND viewed IS NULL

UPDATE report_reviews SET status = #{reviewDbStatus}, review = #{reviewComment, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, reject = #{rejectReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, project_member_id = #{reviewerProjectMemberId}, reviewed = SYSDATE WHERE report_id = #{reviewId} AND status = 0 AND viewed IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN projects p ON pm.project_id = p.project_id WHERE pm.project_member_id = #{reviewerProjectMemberId} AND pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND pm.status = 0 AND wm.status = 0 AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} )

UPDATE tasks t SET progress = ( SELECT LEAST(100, NVL(SUM(tr.progress), 0)) FROM team_reports tr WHERE tr.task_id = t.task_id AND tr.project_id = t.project_id AND tr.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM report_reviews rr WHERE rr.team_report_id = tr.team_report_id AND rr.category = 2 AND rr.status = 1 AND rr.report_id = ( SELECT MAX(last_rr.report_id) FROM report_reviews last_rr WHERE last_rr.team_report_id = tr.team_report_id AND last_rr.category = 2)) ), status = CASE WHEN ( SELECT LEAST(100, NVL(SUM(tr.progress), 0)) FROM team_reports tr WHERE tr.task_id = t.task_id AND tr.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM report_reviews rr WHERE rr.team_report_id = tr.team_report_id AND rr.category = 2 AND rr.status = 1 AND rr.report_id = ( SELECT MAX(r2.report_id) FROM report_reviews r2 WHERE r2.team_report_id = tr.team_report_id AND r2.category = 2))) >= 100 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END, updated = SYSDATE WHERE t.task_id = #{taskId} AND t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.deleted IS NULL

UPDATE projects p SET progress = ( SELECT ROUND(NVL(SUM(t.progress * NVL(t.progress_weight, 0) / 100), 0), 2) FROM tasks t WHERE t.project_id = p.project_id AND t.deleted IS NULL ), status = CASE WHEN p.status = 3 THEN 3 WHEN ( SELECT ROUND(NVL(SUM(t.progress * NVL(t.progress_weight, 0) / 100), 0), 2) FROM tasks t WHERE t.project_id = p.project_id AND t.deleted IS NULL ) >= 100 THEN 2 WHEN p.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE p.status END WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL

SELECT seq_project_reports.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO project_reports (project_report_id, project_id, project_member_id, title, content, progress, status, report_date, created) SELECT #{reportId}, p.project_id, pm.project_member_id, #{reportTitle}, #{content}, NVL(p.progress, 0), 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE FROM project_members pm JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = pm.project_id WHERE pm.project_member_id = #{projectMemberId} AND pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND pm.status = 0 AND p.deleted IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT p.project_id AS "projectId", p.subject || CASE p.status WHEN 2 THEN ' (완료)' WHEN 3 THEN ' (보류)' ELSE '' END AS "projectName", pm.project_member_id AS "projectMemberId", NVL(p.progress, 0) AS "progress" FROM projects p JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project_id = p.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id JOIN workspace_domains wd ON wd.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND pm.status = 0 AND p.deleted IS NULL AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY p.subject

SELECT pm.project_member_id FROM project_members pm JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = pm.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND pm.status = 0 AND wm.status = 0 AND wm.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM report_reviews WHERE project_report_id = #{reportId} AND category = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE report_reviews SET status = 0, viewed = NULL, reviewed = NULL, review = NULL, reject = NULL WHERE project_report_id = #{reportId} AND category = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_files (report_file_id, project_report_id, original_name, stored_name, path, file_size, uploaded) VALUES (seq_report_files.NEXTVAL, #{reportId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{path}, #{fileSize}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND pm.status = 0 AND wm.status = 0 AND wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND (wm.role = 70 OR pm.role = 50) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members author_pm JOIN workspace_members author_wm ON author_wm.workspace_member_id = author_pm.workspace_member_id WHERE author_pm.project_member_id = #{authorProjectMemberId} AND author_wm.member_id = #{memberId})
